This '''Cor village''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gargolyn IV]]. It has the ancestral home of a tribe of [[Cor]], who in the distant past have been attacked by a [[Gargolyn monster|monster]]. Their [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] eventually defeated the monster, binding it within the planet's surface. This remained active so long as the Cor tribe remained living within the village.

The [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] forcibly removed the Cor trive from this village, in order to build a factory there. This casued the beast to emerge and destroy the construction site. It was only subdues when the Cor were returned to the village.
